gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-glegoo: Loosely spaced, high-waisted and quietly commanding: that's Metamorphous. Glegoo lands beside it with a tall, open-mouthed lowercase, so the two feel like a formal hall opening onto a warm, chatty room.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noticia-text: Spacious, high-waisted and quietly commanding, Metamorphous brings a soft, approachable swing between its fat and slim strokes. But Noticia Text takes over with wide-entry curves and tall lowercase bodies, moving the page from ceremony to conversation.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-slabo-13px: Generous side spacing lets Metamorphous swing gently from heavy to light. Slabo 13px brings bookish, dignified lettering with large, clear openings in its rounded letters, a quiet foil for the commanding top.
gen-gf-offside-gf-fauna-one: Curves that refuse to close give Offside its whole personality. Fauna One, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, brings a literary, dignified hush that settles the heading's drama.
gen-gf-offside-gf-glegoo: Wide tracking, open curves and a level, unhurried stride: Offside. Glegoo, a serif with big counters and unclosed curved mouths, sits next to it like a warm lamp beside a bare wall.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hanuman: Offside runs wide-tracked and level, its curves left open and its strokes never swelling or thinning. Hanuman then adds a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, bringing traditional polish to the commanding top.
gen-gf-offside-gf-kadwa: Expressive and commanding, Offside draws wire-like lines with curves left open. Offside is made for making an entrance, while Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, is made for carrying the words.
gen-gf-offside-gf-pridi: Wire-thin joins and open curves give Offside a stark, commanding look. Pridi, with generous space between curve ends and stems and nearly capital-sized small letters, keeps reading smooth and refined paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-offside-gf-scope-one: Expressive and level, Offside keeps its rounds and stems in a single weight. Scope One, with generous counters and stubby ascenders beneath a big x-height, adds traditional refinement to Offside's stark commanding line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-slabo-13px: Offside is all wide tracking and curves that won't close. Its flat, modulation-free strokes make statements, while Slabo 13px does the patient work with large, generous counters in a bookish voice.
